walker: release 2.0.7 combo walk wave 6 (Sonnet) + wave 8 combo (Sonnet)

e-ai.1.evidence: Settings > AI Integration (admin): OpenAI key typed and saved -> field returns '***encrypted***' (key stored encrypted), a 'clear api key' checkbox appears; ticking it and saving removed the key (list-providers api_key_set no). Ollama provider pointed at the walkstub URL, model walkstub.

e-ai.2.evidence: grace (trust 1) posted 'Make $5000 a week from home...' (published); after the batch review run (hook jetonomy_pro_ai_batch_review, stub verdict spam 0.95 >= auto-spam 0.8) it became status spam; a second grace topic at confidence 0.6 (>= hold 0.5, < 0.8) became pending (held).

e-ai.3.evidence: bob's genuine SMTP certificate question stayed published after the batch (stub verdict not spam).

e-ai.4.evidence: Auto-spam Threshold 0.3 (below Hold 0.5): 'Auto-spam Threshold must be at least the Hold Threshold. The previous thresholds were kept.' and the old 0.8 stays; 1.5 is clamped to 1 with only the generic 'AI settings saved.' (no specific clamp message).

e-ai.5.evidence: GET /ai/usage -> 200 rows per day/provider/feature (ollama spam_detection 9 requests today); /ai/usage/summary -> totals (66 requests, 26,000 prompt / 13,000 completion tokens, cost 0.08) and by_provider rows; bob GET /ai/usage -> 403. Rows also include earlier walks' data, so exact add-up was not re-derived.

e-ai.6.evidence: daily_budget 0.01 (already exceeded by recorded cost): a grace spam-looking topic was published unchecked, an admin suggest-reply call fails with 502 'AI request failed. Please try again later.' and wp-admin shows 'Jetonomy AI is not reaching any provider. Last failure ... AI moderation and spam detection are letting content through unchecked until a provider...'. Budget reset to 0 afterwards.

e-ai.7.evidence: no provider configured: bob's composer has no AI button, POST topic 201 publish in 146 ms, nothing in debug.log; CLI list-providers 'No rows.', spam-check/summarize 'No AI provider configured...' as plain errors.

e-ai.8.evidence: Ollama base URL pointed at a dead path: suggest-reply 502, notice 'Jetonomy AI is not reaching any provider. Last failure 1 second ago (suggestion)...' in wp-admin, bob's new topic still 201 publish; after restoring the URL a successful suggest-reply made the notice disappear.

e-ai.9.evidence: Q&A topic in Help Desk, after the suggestion job ran (jetonomy_pro_ai_generate_suggestions): 'AI Suggested Answers' block with a 'Use as reply' button; clicking it put the suggestion text into the composer and posted nothing.

e-ai.10.evidence: Configured Ollama provider (walkstub URL) + thread summaries in Settings > AI Integration (min words field enforces >=100). As bob on Feature Requests topic 249 (66 replies) the AI Summary card (.jt-ai-summary: heading, AI badge, text, 3 key points) rendered after the queued generation ran; posting a new reply (4155) deleted the cached summary row and the card was gone on reload; short topic 402 shows no card.

e-ai.11.evidence: bob POST /ai/suggest-reply post_id 99999999 and post 403 (Customer Advisory Board) -> both 404 'Topic not found.'.

e-ai.12.evidence: bob's 1st-5th successful suggest-reply 200, 6th -> 429 'You have reached the hourly limit for AI requests. Please try again later.'; admin 7 calls in a row all 200.

e-ai.13.evidence: min trust level 3: grace (TL1) POST /ai/suggest-reply -> 403 'You need trust level 3 or higher to use AI features.'; no AI button in her composer or topic page. Reset to 0.

e-ai.14.evidence: guest POST /ai/suggest-reply and GET /ai/usage -> 401; bob GET /ai/usage -> 403.

e-ai.15.evidence: Only an Ollama-shaped stub can answer, so the second provider was a dead Custom endpoint instead of OpenAI/Anthropic: default Custom with order 'custom, ollama' -> spam-check went to ollama after custom logged error_count 1 (next provider in order used); then per-feature override spam_detection=ollama with default Custom -> the call went straight to ollama and custom's error count stayed at 1 (override honoured). Provider names differ from the line, the routing behaviour is as described.

e-ai.16.evidence: Insiders Beta (private) topic 216 with a cached summary: guest page 404 'Page not available' with no .jt-ai-summary element or summary text; guest REST GET /posts/216 and /replies 404; test_subscriber and bob POST /ai/suggest-reply on private/missing topics -> 404 'Topic not found.' and the stub call log did not grow (4 -> 4).

e-ai.17.evidence: Arabic topic (omar, 180 words, 3 replies) summarised: AI Summary card paragraph and key points dir=auto resolve rtl, wrap inside the card at 1440 (right 961) and 390 (right 358 of 390), no horizontal scroll; the moderation flag 'Flagged by AI review: <Arabic reason>' shows in Moderation > Flags (starts Latin so it reads LTR with the Arabic run embedded). The 159-char General Discussion topic summary card wraps at 390 (right 358, no scroll).

e-ai.18.evidence: wp jetonomy-pro ai status, list-providers, provider-status ollama, test-provider ollama, spam-check --content, summarize --content, batch-review-status all answer in plain output with and without a provider (without: 'Unknown provider id' / 'No AI provider configured' errors); no jetonomy notices in debug.log.

e-ai.19.evidence: Batch reviewer (hook jetonomy_pro_ai_batch_review, reply shape {items:[{key,spam,confidence,action}]}): flagged a past post (watermark reset) with a pending flag; with the stub returning 500 the run published content unchanged and kept the watermark at 15856, after clearing the 500 the next cycle marked post 15857 spam and advanced to 15857; with a  daily budget and  spent no model call was made (calls 11 -> 11), the new post stayed published and the log reads 'Batch review failed, will retry next cycle: Daily AI budget exceeded'.

e-ai.20.evidence: Set the site timezone to Pacific/Kiritimati (UTC+14, site date 2026-11-11 while UTC date 2026-11-10): an AI call wrote the usage row under date 2026-11-11, and yesterday's $5 row no longer counted against the budget (batch review ran). Timezone and budget restored afterwards.

e-ai.21.evidence: saving with a rejected threshold shows 'Auto-spam Threshold must be at least the Hold Threshold. The previous thresholds were kept.' followed by 'Your other changes were saved.' (not 'AI settings saved.').

runbook_fixes.now: the threshold-kept notice is followed by Your other changes were saved. instead of AI settings saved.
